About Blushlab

Blushlab is a game that brings a makeup studio and a My Face mode together. It is made by ipe() (ipe Studio) and is in development for iOS and Android. There is no store page or release date yet.

What it includes

  • Makeup Studio: apply face-makeup tools (shadow, liner, lashes, blush, lip, brows and lenses) to a face, step by step.
  • My Face: use a photo of your own face. Photos are processed on your device and are not sent to a server.

Price and ads

Blushlab is free to start, and in-app purchases are available. There are no ads.

Platforms

Blushlab is in development for iOS and Android. Follow the journal for notes from the making of the game, and see Support if you want to write to us.

Who makes it

Blushlab is made by Davy Kim (ipe Studio). Contact: ipe.haven@gmail.com.
